environment.database_migration_rationale: MLflow 2.22.5 natively supports Model Registry on local FileStore (file:./mlruns). Local tracking history with 20+ runs, exact run IDs, and artifact paths are 100% preserved. Installed SQLAlchemy 2.1.6 diverges from requirements.txt (<2.1.0) and lacks FallbackAsyncAdaptedQueuePool; upgrading/downgrading packages is strictly prohibited. FileStore avoids third-party migration risks.

registered_model.name: KRS_Dam_Inflow_Forecaster
registered_model.description: Production candidate inflow forecasting model for KRS Dam (Cauvery Basin). Tuned RandomForestRegressor with 19 dam lag/rolling/calendar features. Acceptance status is CONDITIONAL per Phase 2 Step 1 quality evaluation (RMSE: 5935.09 cfs, MAE: 2335.17 cfs, R²: 0.5899, 80% interval coverage: 77.05%). NOT approved for automated production dispatch without operational review.

lineage.packaging_rationale: Direct registration from original verified training run artifact (runs:/157ee4e92e284c82a63f385d6c4c9469/model).

operational_conditions: Low-flow and flat-baseflow regimes: Persistence remains competitive; use ensemble blending or baseline cross-check.
High-flow monsoon surge peaks: Prediction intervals exhibit conservative bounds; manual reservoir flood gating overrides required.
Historical archive mode: Real-time telemetry is not connected; operational deployment requires live CWC/telemetry feed integration.
